caseName: Zivnostenska Banka, National Corp. v. Stephen
caseNameFull: ZIVNOSTENSKA BANKA, NATIONAL CORPORATION, v. STEPHEN, Formerly Known as AUGSTEIN, Et Al.
attorneys: Lemuel Skidmore for appellant., Sigmund Timberg for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion for leave to file brief of Frank Petschek et al., as amici curiae, is granted. The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
